courses.overview: 從拓撲、狀態估計與模型版本一致性延伸至相近領域；相似物理不代表同一設備規格或驗收程序。
courses.overviewEn: Extend topology, state estimation and model revision consistency to neighboring domains; shared physics does not imply identical equipment requirements or acceptance procedures.

related.title: 電網廣域相量量測
related.why: 同步量測可更新模型狀態
related.whyEn: Synchronized measurements can update model state
related.transfer: 同步量測可更新模型狀態
related.transferEn: Synchronized measurements can update model state
related.difference: 數位分身還需資產版本與拓撲治理
related.differenceEn: Digital twins also need asset and topology governance
practice: 以「資產識別」為起點，畫出本課與「電網廣域相量量測」可共用及須重畫的系統邊界。
針對「數位分身還需資產版本與拓撲治理」各選一項能區分兩課的量測。
將本課算例移植到新情境：保留方程依據，重新指定單位、材料或拓撲，並標示無法沿用的數值。
practiceEn: Start from asset identity and mark shared/redefined boundaries with wide-area phasor measurement.
For the difference "Digital twins also need asset and topology governance", choose discriminating measurements for both courses.
Transfer the worked example: retain justified equations, respecify units, materials or topology and identify values that cannot transfer.

roles.role: 提供電網數位分身與模型管理軟體，可對照拓樸。
roles.roleEn: Provides grid digital-twin and model-management software, relevant to topology.
roles.business: 工業自動化、智慧基礎設施（配電與電網控制）、EDA 與工業軟體。
roles.businessEn: Industrial automation, smart infrastructure (distribution and grid control), EDA and industrial software.

roles.role: 提供電網軟體，可對照狀態估計。
roles.roleEn: Provides grid software, relevant to state estimation.
roles.business: 燃氣／汽輪與水力發電、風電，以及 HVDC、FACTS、保護電驛與電網軟體。
roles.businessEn: Gas/steam and hydro power, wind, and HVDC, FACTS, protection relays and grid software.

roles.role: 旗下 Hitachi Energy 提供電網資產管理軟體，可對照本課的模型修訂一致性。
roles.roleEn: Its Hitachi Energy unit provides grid asset software, relevant to model-revision consistency here.
roles.business: 日立集團母公司；旗下 Hitachi Energy 提供 HVDC、變壓器與電網設備，Hitachi High-Tech 提供量測與蝕刻設備。
roles.businessEn: Parent of the Hitachi group; Hitachi Energy supplies HVDC, transformers and grid equipment, and Hitachi High-Tech supplies metrology and etch tools.
